value.label: Corrected terminal accounting: the finite-real regret identity
value.plain: An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.
value.fallback: Regret equals the final comparator regularizer minus the initial played regularizer, plus within-potential differences, interior regularizer drift and the terminal cumulative-objective gap.
value.relationship: This is the finite-real corrected algebra subclause of repair:7.47-terminal, related to the terminal correction of Theorem15.31; it is not the literal full printed theorem. The source uses Euclidean feasible states and extended losses; the algebra abstracts the carrier and uses globally real functions. Repeating a virtual final hint is legitimate, but omitting its terminal residual can invalidate the sharp bound. The full EReal adapter, actual optimistic-FTRL/BTRL producers, ghost attainment, support qualification, strong-convex stability, Young estimate and whole corrected7.47/15.31 bounds remain open. A positive arbitrary terminal gap cannot be discarded.

contract.model: Exact deterministic accounting for arbitrary states and functions; no algorithmic run is asserted. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.
contract.assumptions: An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate.
contract.parameters: T is a positive natural number. u and z are independent arbitrary states; no relation between z and original x(T).
contract.regret: R_T(u)=sum_{t<T}(loss_t(y_t)-loss_t(u)); the scored states are unchanged by the terminal splice.
contract.guarantee: Full equality including every endpoint and drift term. The full EReal adapter, actual optimistic-FTRL/BTRL producers, ghost attainment, support qualification, strong-convex stability, Young estimate and whole corrected7.47/15.31 bounds remain open. A positive arbitrary terminal gap cannot be discarded.
